title: Write the CI workflow and config for your repository

rules.message: Кроки: setup-python з `cache: pip` → `pip install -r requirements.txt` → `python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium`.

model.workflow:
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 4 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Install Chromium
        run: python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run tests
        run: >
          python -m pytest
          --junitxml=reports/junit.xml
          --html=reports/report.html --self-contained-html
          --tracing retain-on-failure --screenshot only-on-failure

      - name: Upload reports
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: test-reports
          path: |
            reports/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14
model.config:
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "9.0"
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["."]
addopts = "-ra --strict-markers"
markers = [
    "smoke: critical checks for every pull request",
    "api: tests without a browser",
    "ui: browser tests",
]
xfail_strict = true
base_url = "https://practicesoftwaretesting.com"

checklist: setup-python з кешем pip, залежності з requirements.txt, Chromium з --with-deps
JUnit XML, HTML-звіт одним файлом, трейси лише для упалих
Жодного пароля чи токена у файлах — лише secrets, якщо знадобляться
